keys.note: Every Orca chord lives in this one section, which Herdr applies only while layouts/orca.json shows. No Orca binding exists in global or terminal.

local_fits: mods/better-changes/mod.json: place set to none (layout provides the slot)
mods/better-config/main.js: PowerShell listing on Windows instead of /bin/sh (upstream kept as main.js.bak-upstream)
mods/desktop-notifications/mod.json: place set to none; the Orca layout carries its 0px block explicitly, so it can no longer inject itself into other layouts
layouts/workbench-saved.json + .state: injected desktop-notifications block removed (.bak-scope backups beside them)

mods/better-sidebar/views/spaces.js: first space on a repo's main checkout is the project root; sibling spaces on the same checkout nest under it with worktrees (upstream nested worktrees only). Nested siblings no longer draw the 'primary' badge. Upstream kept as views/spaces.js.bak-upstream.

mods/files-open-with: right-click menu now opens on every platform with built-in 'Insert path into terminal' and 'Copy path' (upstream menu was macOS-only Open With apps). Insert reuses the workspace-files approach in insert.js: capture the focused terminal at right-click, clipboard write + verify, focus, native paste.
mods/files-open-with: dropdown gained 'Move to Recycle Bin' (trash, never permanent) with an in-menu confirm step; the project root itself can't be deleted from the panel.

mods/better-sidebar: projects are permanent. Every repo a space opens is remembered (better-sidebar.pinned-projects); after its last space closes it stays as a dimmed 'closed' row — click reopens a space at the repo root, the small x is the only way to remove it.

mods/files-open-with viewer: local files are editable (upstream read-only): Ctrl+S / Save button writes via compare-and-swap writeTextFile, unsaved dot + Saved/Not saved states, drafts kept in localStorage, external changes never clobber unsaved edits. Remote/binary/truncated stay read-only.

mods/files-open-with panel: opening a file no longer resets the Files panel outside the project — when the focused pane has no folder (a viewer tab), the root falls back to the space's first terminal folder instead of the space's home folder.

mods/better-sidebar: worktrees always show — each pinned project's git worktrees are enumerated (better-sidebar.worktrees, 30s refresh) and closed ones nest under the project as dimmed rows; a repo fold no longer hides worktree rows. Delete: live worktree rows have an x opening Orca's worktree remove dialog; closed worktree rows have an x with an inline Remove/Cancel confirm running git worktree remove --force --force (branch kept).

Automations removed from the bundle by user request: mods/automations, its sidebar-nav link and icon, data/automations, the plugin config and state folders, the Go source in bundles/orca/src, the build and scheduler scripts, and the herdr-automations binary are gone, and the HerdrOrcaAutomations scheduled task is unregistered at removal time. No automations were defined at removal time (automations: []). remove.ps1 still unregisters the legacy task by name so an old install cleans up fully.

Excalidraw removed from the bundle by user request: mods/excalidraw and its top-bar button in my-tabs are gone, the layout:orca chord cmd-shift-e was removed, and the right panel gained a prs child running the workspace github-prs mod (top bar shows a PRs button, like the workbench). github-prs itself is NOT bundle-owned — it is the shared workbench mod (herdr-app/mods/github-prs); the orca installer copies it in for portability, but bundle removal leaves it in place.
remove: Run remove.ps1 from this folder. It switches away first if Orca is showing, then deletes everything listed here and nothing else.
